scope: Read-only evidence-packager source review plus portable tests and independent existing-capture/inventory audits; no library source changes or hardware execution.

findings.problem: Truthy manifest/submission guards accepted an empty parsed JSON object as absent, bypassing required terminal status/completion records.
findings.resolution: Changed presence checks to is not None; portable rejection test now covers empty validation and submission objects as well as running state.

preservation_checks: Original evidence is opened read-only. New output is built in a temporary sibling and atomically renamed; existing captures are verified rather than overwritten.
Raw bytes use tar members without text decoding; gzip metadata and tar member metadata are deterministic. Inventory retains original path, length, source SHA256 and storage location.
Generated C++ probes and raw stdout/stderr are archived; scripts, manifests, indices and handwritten template/explicit --input files remain visible.

Source worktrees, CMake builds and compiler products are deliberately pruned. Exact immutable revisions/source hashes remain visible in validation manifests and assembly snapshots; original ignored products remain untouched.
Completed validation status/finished record or explicit cancellation receipt is required. Attempt manifests are hashed before and after capture.

Directory traversal does not follow symlinks. Label traversal/absolute paths and duplicate/reserved members are rejected; verification checks archive inventory, regular-file safety, lengths and hashes.

validation.portable_tests: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tools/review_stack -p test_capture.py -v: PASS (2 tests, 0.803 seconds)
validation.existing_captures: capture.py --verify PASS for cancelled-1011368 (14 files), foundations-1011365 (93 files), intermediates-1011366 (3164 files)
validation.top_level_manifest_references: All 1104 stdout/stderr references present with matching SHA256 (68 foundation + 1036 intermediate). See capture-reference-audit.json.
validation.visible_input_inventory: No missing visible files and no .py/.sh/.md/.json/.in/.yml/.yaml files unexpectedly stored only in archives.

limitations: No assumption that a preserved failed/cancelled attempt passed; those statuses remain unchanged.
Verification reads and hashes archives, and never extracts members into the filesystem.
The packaging audit establishes byte preservation, not successful formatter or hardware qualification.
